subject: Expo badge scan debounce: mapping & HubSpot handoff
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@leadcapture.io>, logistics@expotech.com
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Expo badge scan debounce: mapping & HubSpot handoff

Hi Sarah / ExpoTech team,

Quick heads-up from last night's booth shift: we saw a non-trivial number of duplicate lead rows coming from the badge scanner batch file. Sample CSV attached (expo_scan_sample.csv). Duplicates look like small timing collisions (same badge scanned twice within 3s) and also a separate case where the same attendee hit both QR and badge scan.

Current problem: the HubSpot ingestion job treats each row as a distinct contact if the email field is blank and we only dedupe on Email + Phone. For a lot of field captures we have only name + company + badge_id. That is creating duplicate lead records and bloating our pipeline.

Can LeadCapture suggest a debounce / heuristic config we can run in the ingest layer before HubSpot? Ideally we would:
- collapse rows with identical badge_id within a 15s window
- prefer rows with an email when merging
- output a single canonical row with a notes field listing scan_timestamps and source (badge|qr)

Attachments: expo_scan_sample.csv (100 rows, scrambled PII), and our current debounce config (debounce_config_v2.pdf) for context.

Ask: Sarah, can your team propose two options: (A) lightweight pre-ingest debounce we can run on the CSV, and (B) a more robust server-side dedupe you can run before sending to HubSpot? Vanessa - is there an SLA window you need for turnaround ahead of Monday's event?

Thanks,

Priyom
Priyom Das
Field Marketing, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@leadcapture.io>

Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expo badge scan debounce: mapping & HubSpot handoff

Thanks for the examples, Priyom — useful context. We can do both options. High-level proposals below; I attached a short runbook (handoff-runbook.md) with CLI examples.

Option A — Lightweight CSV pre-ingest (fast):
- Deduplicate by badge_id within a configurable window (default 15s).
- Merge rows by preferring fields: email > phone > company > name.
- Emit canonical_row and a metadata column scan_history (json blob).
- Runtime: local script, < 2m for 10k rows.

Option B — Server-side dedupe (safe, idempotent):
- Our server will accept the raw batch, run badge_id clustering (time-decay), and reconcile against existing HubSpot contacts via email and badge_id custom property.
- Add mapping rules for blank-email contacts: create a contact with badge_id set and a lifecycle stage of lead; avoid creating duplicates if a contact with the same badge_id exists.
- Provide dry-run report and delta CSV before we push to HubSpot.

Quick notes:
- For the no-email flows we recommend creating a contact-level custom property "badge_id" and setting dedupe priority to badge_id + name match.
- For HubSpot we can deliver a delta import file compatible with the HubSpot import UI or push via API (we will need an API key or OAuth token with import/write scope).

I'll sync with your ops team on the auth details. If you want, we can run Option A today and schedule Option B for production on Monday morning.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Kim
Client Success Lead, LeadCapture.io
sarah.kim@leadcapture.io | +1 206-555-0148
